vendor_note: Not an EHR — the national e-prescribing / medication-history network (EHR spec §6). Netbox is never the thing that originates or intercepts a real prescription transaction (that stays inside the EHR's certified e-prescribing module). What Netbox legitimately checks: network-path health (L0-L2 generic checks) to the site's configured Surescripts gateway endpoint, mapped onto the existing service: 'eprescribe' enum value. NOT a native Surescripts network integration (requires Surescripts' own vendor certification — explicitly out of scope).
